category: Armor, Power Armor, and Inherent Damage Reduction Formulas

powerArmorInherentBonuses.flatDamageReduction: 42% flat damage reduction applied before all armor resistance calculations (7% per individual piece on a full chassis).
powerArmorInherentBonuses.flatRadiationReduction: 90% flat incoming radiation reduction applied before all Rad Resistance calculations (15% per individual piece).
powerArmorInherentBonuses.fallDamageImmunity: 100% immunity to fall damage when inside any Power Armor chassis.

powerArmorSets.name: Hellcat Power Armor
powerArmorSets.inherentSetBonus: +12% additional flat Ballistic Damage Reduction (2% per piece, stacking with the baseline 42% PA reduction to 54% total ballistic reduction).
powerArmorSets.acquisition: Steel Reign questline completion / Gold Bullion (Regs at Vault 79 / Mortimer).
powerArmorSets.idealBuilds: Maximum Ballistic Survivability, Heavy Gunner Tanks

powerArmorSets.name: Union Power Armor
powerArmorSets.inherentSetBonus: Full set grants +150 Poison Resistance and +75 Maximum Carry Weight.
powerArmorSets.idealBuilds: Daily Ops Poison Hazards, Moonshine Jamboree, Heavy Carry Weight Builds

powerArmorSets.name: Strangler Heart Power Armor
powerArmorSets.inherentSetBonus: Adds acid damage to all armed attacks and emits an acidic aura damaging nearby enemies.
powerArmorSets.acquisition: Vault 79 Gold Bullion (Regs) / Vault 94 Legacy Plans.
powerArmorSets.idealBuilds: High Fire-Rate Heavy Weapons, Melee Close Quarters

powerArmorSets.name: T-65 Power Armor
powerArmorSets.inherentSetBonus: Highest raw Damage Resistance (565 DR), Energy Resistance (470 ER), and Radiation Resistance (470 RR) of all traditional frames.

powerArmorSets.name: Excavator Power Armor
powerArmorSets.inherentSetBonus: Full set grants +100 Maximum Carry Weight (+200 with Calibrated Shocks) and 4x Ore Mining Yields.

regularBodyArmorSets.name: Civil Engineer Armor

regularBodyArmorSets.name: Secret Service Armor
regularBodyArmorSets.inherentSetBonus: Highest balanced raw resistances across DR (250), ER (220), and RR (220) with Jet Pack chest mod compatibility.

regularBodyArmorSets.name: Brotherhood Recon Armor
regularBodyArmorSets.inherentSetBonus: High physical ballistic resistance (DR 377) with Jet Pack compatibility.
regularBodyArmorSets.acquisition: Daily Ops rare drops / Minerva Sales.

regularBodyArmorSets.name: Solar Armor
regularBodyArmorSets.inherentSetBonus: Heals the wearer and all nearby teammates by 4 HP/second when the wearer's Health is at or above 60%.

regularBodyArmorSets.name: Thorn Armor
